about-intro.text: Finding inspiration in every turn. WhenWhere is an event production company based in Charlottesville, serving weddings and private events across Central Virginia — the DJ & MC, the sound, the lighting, and, from 2027, the sky itself.

about-story-1.text: WhenWhere started with a simple observation: the nights people remember aren’t the ones with the fanciest kit — they’re the ones where everything just worked. The vows landed clearly at the back row. The speeches were crisp. Dinner flowed into dancing without a gap, and the floor never emptied.

about-story-2.text: So we built one team to own all of it — DJ & MC flow, multi-zone audio for vineyards and remote sites, and lighting that turns a barn into a ballroom — under a single contract and a single point of contact, with backup gear for everything that matters. No hand-offs, no gaps, no awkward silences.

about-story-3.text: In 2027 we add our newest chapter: drone light shows, writing couples’ initials, dates, and logos in light above their guests. Same crew, same obsession — a bigger canvas.

about-team-intro.text: The people behind the heartbeat. Full names and portraits are on their way — here’s who does what on your night.

cal-intro.text: A quick look at which dates are open, on hold, or booked — then send an inquiry and we’ll confirm your exact date personally. Only a date, a status, and a short public note are ever shown here — never client names, venues, or prices.

cal-tip-1-desc.text: Fall Saturdays in vineyard country and UVA alumni weekends are the most requested dates of the year. If your heart is set on one, ask as early as you can — even a rough date holds your place in the conversation.

cal-tip-2-desc.text: Most couples reach out months ahead so we can build the run-of-show with their planner and caterer. Shorter notice isn’t impossible — it depends on the date and the venue, so it’s always worth asking.

cal-tip-3-desc.text: Drone light shows need extra lead time for custom design and airspace authorisations. The 2027 founding-season interest list is open now, with priority dates for early inquiries.

faq-1-a.text: Two things, one team: DJ & MC and full event production for weddings and private events, and drone light shows, launching with a 2027 founding season. Book one, or stack them — a wedding with a drone finale is our favourite kind of night.

faq-2-a.text: Charlottesville and Central Virginia are home — Albemarle County, the Blue Ridge foothills, and the vineyard and estate country around them. Further afield in Virginia? Ask in the inquiry and we’ll talk.

faq-3-a.text: As early as you can — fall Saturdays and UVA alumni weekends go first, and drone shows need extra lead time for design and airspace authorisations. Even a rough date in the inquiry below holds your place in the conversation.

faq-4-a.text: It depends on the event — venue, guest count, production, and how custom you want it — so everything is quoted individually rather than off a one-size price list. Send the inquiry with a rough budget and we’ll tell you honestly what it can do.

manifesto-1.text: At WHEN & WHERE, our goal is to provide the heartbeat to your celebration.

manifesto-2.text: Long after the final toast is raised and the last song is played, what you—and your guests—will remember most is how the night felt.

manifesto-3.text: From the laughter carrying across the room, to the clarity of the speeches, and the magnetic pull of a dance floor that nobody wants to leave, our ambition is to make an evening that will resonate for a lifetime.

rev-desc.text: WhenWhere is a new name for this work, and we’d rather show you nothing than dress up words nobody said. As our first wedding and event seasons under this name wrap up, real reviews from real clients will live here — unedited and in their own words.

services-heading.text: Two ways to have a night

services-intro.text: Everything WhenWhere does comes back to the same two questions — when, and where. Pick your lane; the same crew, the same production standards, and the same obsession with the dance floor run through both.

team-1-desc.text: Owns the run-of-show and the room — music curation, pacing, and the voice guiding your guests from first arrival to last song.

team-2-desc.text: Sound and lighting across vineyards, barns, and estates — load-in routes, power quirks, and redundant systems, handled before guests arrive.

team-3-desc.text: Designs and flies the 2027 founding-season light shows — custom formations previewed with you as an animation before show night.

wed-heading.text: Production that disappears — so the party doesn’t have to

wed-intro.text: Central Virginia’s best venues weren’t built for modern production. We’ve run sound at them anyway — load-in routes, power quirks, and noise ordinances handled before your guests arrive. No hand-offs, no gaps, no awkward silences.

wed-svc-1-desc.text: Custom-curated music that sounds like you, pacing that keeps the night moving, and an MC who guides the room without ever stealing it. We build your run-of-show with your planner and caterer and cue every transition.

wed-svc-2-desc.text: Vows at the top of the vineyard, cocktails on the terrace, dinner in the barn. Multi-zone systems put clear sound exactly where your guests are — even where there’s no power.

wed-svc-3-desc.text: Light is the fastest way to make a barn feel like a ballroom. Wireless uplighting and dance-floor washes shift the room from golden hour to late night as the energy builds.

wed-svc-4-desc.text: Add a drone light show to the reception and the same team times it into your timeline — first dance, send-off, or the moment dinner ends and the party begins.

wed-svc-4-title.text: And the sky, if you want it

why-1-desc.text: DJ, MC, sound, lighting — and now the sky — under a single point of contact. Nothing falls between vendors because there’s only one vendor.

why-2-desc.text: Every critical piece travels in duplicate: two sound systems, two laptops, backup controllers, spare microphones, supplemental battery power. A failure becomes a thirty-second swap your guests won’t notice.

why-3-desc.text: Estates, vineyards, barns and fairgrounds across Albemarle and Central Virginia — we know where the outlets are, and where they aren’t.

why-4-desc.text: We build the run-of-show with your planner and caterer, cue every transition, and keep the night on rails — so the only thing you have to watch is the sunset over the Blue Ridge.

why-heading.text: Reliable is a system, not a promise
